description: A safe LibreWolf Violentmonkey user script for Zapia Chat labels and guarded bulk management.

userStories.title: Manage Zapia chats with labels and guarded bulk deletion
userStories.description: As a Zapia user, I can manage selected visible chats in bulk and act on the current chat through keyboard shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: Adds accessible ✔ and 🟡 prefix actions without stacking or duplicating managed prefixes.
Provides a separate accessible side panel for selecting visible chats, without covering Canvas chat titles, and collapses it into an unobtrusive launcher.
Deletion opens and confirms Zapia's native flow one selected chat at a time.
Deletion confirmation is scoped to the visible native `Excluir conversa?` dialog, never a menu action.
`Alt+Shift+C`, `Alt+Shift+Y`, and `Alt+Shift+X` respectively prefix the current chat with ✔, prefix it with 🟡, and delete it.
Shortcuts do not intercept typing or repeated keydown events.
Tests cover prefix replacement, row discovery, selection, native-delete exclusions, and keyboard chord recognition.
userStories.notes: Version 0.2.14 adds current-chat shortcuts: `Alt+Shift+C` for ✔, `Alt+Shift+Y` for 🟡, and `Alt+Shift+X` for deletion. The handler runs in capture phase only for exact non-repeated chords, ignores editable targets, and invokes the existing native action paths. An isolated authenticated Zapia probe opened `🟡 Zotero`, dispatched `Alt+Shift+C`, observed `defaultPrevented: true` and exactly one intercepted native-action click without mutating chat data. The installed Tampermonkey source is 0.2.14; Node syntax and 13 tests passed.
